title: The Unmaking Spring
text: Clear water rises in a ring of white stones. The moss around it grows in the shape of whatever drinks there, before they came here.

options.label: Let the strangest of you bathe in it.

outcomes.text: The water is cold and clean. Whatever was not theirs washes off.
The water is cold, and nothing changes but their mood.
It tastes of nothing at all. It is the best water any of you have had.
